tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun sa skya pa'i gdung rabs la brten pa'i bka' bsgo/ oṃ swasti/ rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa nyid dang mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po ro mnyam pa'i zab mo chos kyi sku/ nges pa lnga dang ldan zhing theg chen gyi chos la rdzogs par longs spyod pa'i longs spyod rdzogs sku/ srid pa ji srid pa de srid du 'gro phan sna tshogs mdzad pa'i sprul pa'i sku/ de dag gi mkhyen pa'i ye shes rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ brtse ba'i thugs rje phyag na pad dkar mthu stobs dbang phyug gsang ba'i bdag po rnams kyi rang bzhin/ spyi ring / g.yu ring / g.yu se/ ma sangs spyi rje/ dpa' bo stag stag po 'od can/ g.ya' spang skyes kyi bar du byon pa'i 'od gsal lha'i gdung rabs rnams dang / 'khon bar skyes/ dpal po che/ klu'i dbang po/ rdo rje rin chen/ shes rab yon tan/ yon tan 'byung gnas/ tshul khrims rgyal po/ gtsug tor shes rab/ dge skyabs/ dge mthong / 'khon ston bal po/ shākya blo gros/ shes rab tshul khrims kyi bar du byon pa'i mthu chen 'khon gyi gdung rabs rnams dang / dkon mchog rgyal po/ brtse chen kun dga' snying po/ kun dga' 'bar/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ dpal chen 'od po/ sa paṇḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ bzang tsha bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ 'phags chen blo gros rgyal mtshan/ phyag na rdo rje/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/ ye shes rgyal mtshan/ dharmā pha la ratna bha drwa/ bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal/ bsod nams bzang po/ ratna shrī/ ta shrī kun dga' blo gros kyi bar du byon pa'i dpal ldan sa skya pa spyi la dbang ba'i gdung rabs rnams dang / nyi ma dpal/ kun dga' legs pa'i rgyal mtshan/ bsod nams blo gros/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' legs pa'i blo gros/ rnam sras rgyal mtshan/ chos rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' blo gros/ nam mkha' legs pa/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/

nam mkha' rin chen/ nam mkha' bkra shis/ sa lo tsā ba 'jam pa'i dbyasang kun dga' bsod nams/ grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ ngag gi dbang phyug 'jam dpal grags pa/ tshe brtan bkra shis/ kun dga' bsam 'grub/ dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po/ sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ sgar chen mthu stobs dbang phyug rje btsun kun dga' dbang rgyal/ dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal tshan dpal bzang po/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis/ rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ gang de'i dal 'byor gyi lus rten bzang por rjes su bzung ba ngos spun gnyis kyi mi brgyud yod las che/ gzhan yang rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas byang sems/ rang rgyal nyan thos grub pa rig 'dzin/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/ chos srung gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa zhes brjod na skyabs gnas rag pa rnams pha lam 'dis khongs su 'thus 'dra zhing / nang gsal kyi dbye ba la ni bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ dper mtshon na da lta'i bskal bzang 'di'i sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig gser thub/ 'od srung gsum gyi bstan pa rdzogs nas bdag cag gi ston pa'i bstan pa'i dbang du byas na'ang sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi nas gsungs pa'i skyabs gnas bsam gyis mi khyab cing / de dag gi brgyud pa 'dzin pa'i mkhas grub kyang 'phags yul du ji snyed byon pa rnams dang / bod du bstan pa snga dar phyi dar la rgyal ba'i bstan pa mthun zhing / mkhas grub so sos bkral ba'i grub mtha' rigs mi gcig pa du ma bzhugs pa'i rnam 'dren dam pa so so'i mtshan nas smos tshod med cing rang re rje btsun sa skya pa la bka' babs pa'i chos skor rgya mtsho lta bu'i brgyud pa'ang mang ches pas 'dir don gyi snying po 'chi med 'khon rigs sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud spyi dang bye brag nged rang spun gyi rus pa ni dus mchod bla brang pa yin pas bka' bsgo spyir btang tsam la brgyud rim 'dis ma 'thus pa mi 'dug cing /
